scope: Existing root GPU captures of one browser player plus one real SDK peer, HUD enabled. No new execution performed for this archive.
sourceHashScope: Five original remote-jump freeze hashes rechecked at archival time and matching the documented reviewed Game77c79081 source. Not a hash of the complete development scene or a frozen production benchmark.

provenance.images: Original bytes copied from cache; capturedAtUtc taken from the corresponding original capture index.
provenance.observations: Images independently inspected during archival; input/position, console, resolution and cleanup metadata below were reported by the root operator.
provenance.driverLogs: No raw SDK stdout file was present in the supplied cache. Reported runtime/cleanup values are explicitly operator observations, not a reconstructed raw transcript.
provenance.lod: Near/distant name the viewing setups. The cache folder named medium-frames does not prove an actual medium LOD counter.

setup.positioning: Normal canonical input through the actual server physics; no privileged teleport or fabricated motion snapshots.
setup.runFlagMeaning: The driver mode named running sends movement with run:false; these GPU captures do not prove Shift sprint jumping.

limits: Functional visuals only; screenshot bursts affect the instantaneous HUD FPS, which is not used as a benchmark.
This is a development scene without a whole-production source snapshot; GeForce acceptance and a stable production checkpoint remain pending.
Actual avatar LOD was not independently read; quality/distance are setup observations only.
No per-frame network-contact or contact-shadow telemetry was saved. Precise foot-clearance and first-contact timing remain CPU-test evidence.
The distant character is small and sometimes car-occluded. The selected still frames cannot establish uninterrupted gait quality.
Only Eli was exercised in this GPU run. Sam and true run:true sprint scenarios remain separate CPU evidence.
The complete original capture indexes include additional cache frames; only the six selected image files are archived here.
Driver/config .txt files retain their original relative paths and are provenance copies, not relocated runnable scripts.
